title: Node.js libuv thread pool starvation under synchronous filesystem calls inside async handlers
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0857: Node.js libuv thread pool starvation under synchronous filesystem calls inside async handlers
Repository: `nodejs/node`
Category: `Asynchronous Event Loop Deadlocks`
Target File: `src/node_file.cc`

#### Problem Description
Sync fs.statSync calls in HTTP route exhaustion exhaust UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE, blocking DNS resolution threads.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Delegate filesystem operations to non-blocking uv_fs work queue with dedicated worker pool.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0857.py -q`
expected_invariant: Delegate filesystem operations to non-blocking uv_fs work queue with dedicated worker pool.
